messages:
zoe: onboarding example fails in Cloudflare after exports map change. worker errors on import vs require. stack: TypeError: Cannot use import statement outside a module

maria: can you paste package.json exports? which SDK version?

zoe: sdk redwood-js-sdk@1.4.0. exports: { ".": { "types": "./dist/index.d.ts", "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" }, "./server": "./dist/server.cjs" }

sam: likely the bundler grabbed the node-only ./server CJS file into the worker bundle. Cloudflare/other edge runtimes expect ESM.

sam: fixes: (1) add a dedicated ./edge export pointing at the ESM build and update examples to use it for worker bundles, or (2) make the import target the package default so resolvers prefer ESM. option 1 is safer.

maria: agree. also add README note marking ./server as node-only and add a wrangler bundle CI check.

ci-bot: Published redwood-js-sdk@1.4.1 — change: add ./edge export mapping to ESM; smoke tests: wrangler (pass), node (pass).

zoe: confirmed the onboarding example boots in Workers after the upgrade. thanks everyone! :tada:
